defects.title: Evidence count mismatch between static and interactive
defects.description: Static evidence.json contains 29 evidence items; interactive ursa-data.ts SOURCES array contains only 10. Interactive app undercounts the evidence base by 19 items.
defects.evidence: md5 comparison of public/dossier/assets/evidence.json vs grep of src/lib/ursa-data.ts SOURCES array
defects.fix: Add missing evidence items to interactive SOURCES, or add a link from the interactive Sources view to the full static evidence.json

defects.title: Evidence status inflation toward 'verified'
defects.description: 28 of 29 evidence items (96.6%) in evidence.json are marked status:verified. This rate is not credible for public-source research based on Instagram bios, Rappi listings, and search snippets.
defects.evidence: python3 analysis of evidence.json status field distribution
defects.fix: Re-grade evidence statuses: items based on single-platform observation -> 'observed'; items from multiple independent sources -> 'verified'; items inferred -> 'partial'; gaps -> 'gap'

defects.title: Archives referenced in execution prompt do not exist
defects.description: Execution prompt references workspace-*.tar, workspace-*.zip, ursaCoffeeMarketingAndDesign(1).zip, and Pasted text(26).txt. None exist on the filesystem.
defects.fix: Proceed with available archives; document the absence

defects.title: Social statistics hardcoded and may be stale
defects.description: Dashboard reports '4,746 followers, 206 posts' for @ursacoffeeperu, hardcoded in ursa-data.ts from a 2026-08-01 snapshot. No retrieval-date mechanism refreshes them.
defects.evidence: grep of URSA_FACTS in ursa-data.ts shows hardcoded follower/post counts
defects.fix: Add retrieval date next to social stats; add a note that counts are point-in-time snapshots

defects.title: Financial headline may be stronger than scenario inputs justify
defects.description: Dashboard headline states 'net profit is S/. 35.60/subscriber/month' for Ursa Mañana. This is a default-scenario output, not a validated range across sensitivity.
defects.evidence: calculator-view.tsx default PRESETS produce S/. 35.59 at default inputs
defects.fix: Ensure headline always reads 'at default assumptions' and links to the sensitivity table; add worst-case scenario to the headline area

defects.title: Customer-voice findings lack reproducible sampling method
defects.description: Market view reports customer-voice themes without documenting sample size, observation period, coding methodology, or inclusion/exclusion criteria.
defects.evidence: market-view.tsx CUSTOMER_VOICE array has no method documentation
defects.fix: Add a methodology callout to the market view documenting the sample, period, platforms, and coding approach; or downgrade the claims to 'illustrative themes requiring validation'

defects.title: Proposed colors presented without official/observed/proposed labels
defects.description: Brand audit presents a 16-color palette with hex values but does not distinguish which are official (from owner guidelines), observed (sampled from social media), approximate, or proposed.
defects.evidence: brand-audit-view.tsx PALETTE array has no provenance field
defects.fix: Add a provenance field to each palette token: official | observed | approximate | proposed | unknown

defects.title: Static and interactive reports may disagree on counts
defects.description: Static dossier reports 29 evidence items; interactive reports 10 sources. Experiments match (11=11). Content concepts (26) and competitors (10) are interactive-only with no static equivalent.
defects.fix: Synchronize counts; add interactive-only data to static dossier or vice versa
